newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyon-Satolas appoints freight marketing manager.
newsitem.headline: Lyon-Satolas appoints freight marketing manager.

text.p: Lyon-Satolas Airport has appointed a new freight marketing manager.

Eric Beurdin, has replaced Stephan Lafay, who earlier this year was appointed marketing manager at French handling operator, France Handling, Lyon-Satolas' commercial development manager, Jean-Roger Revellin, told Reuters.
Beurdin, 30, was previously with French transport and logistics company Sylog.

Lyon-Satolas Airport is set to create a new, full-time post, in the coming weeks at air cargo community liaison committee, Infofret, which brings together shippers, air forwarding agents and airlines, Revellin said.
"Previously, Infofret formed part of the freight marketing manager's brief but we have decided to create a specific post in line with a strategy to dedicate more staff to cargo operations."
